# UnmirrorCameraPreview - [![Download][download-badge]][download-link]

[download-badge]: https://img.shields.io/badge/Download-%233a71c1.svg?style=flat&logo=data:image/png;base64,
[download-link]: https://github.com/Lehanchic25/UnmirrorCameraPreview/releases/

Plugin for Better Discord that forcibly removes mirroring for local user camera preview by applying scaleX(1) to .media-engine-video.

## How to download plugin?
Go to Releases. Download the last version. Put "UnmirrorCameraPreview.plugin.js" file in plugins folder (%appdata%\BetterDiscord\plugins)
